title: [E16-12] Firmware, Local Summary and Privacy Test Matrix
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-12 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a tester, I want a firmware and privacy test matrix, so wearable simulation and hardware behaviors can be demonstrated reliably.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Test / Validation  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-045  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:B`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E12-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/162), [E12-13](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/163), [E12-12](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/164), [E12-14](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/170), [E12-15](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/171)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: E12-11, E12-13; additional proposed blockers: E12-12, E12-14, E12-15.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Test valid/invalid IMU, threshold, rest/reset, motor, disconnect, false alerts, capacity opt-in and network non-upload; record actual outcomes.
- [ ] Cover valid/invalid IMU, threshold boundary, rest/reset, cooldown and motor behavior.
- [ ] Include disconnect/reconnect, false reminders, local deletion and capacity independence.
- [ ] Record expected/observed results, firmware/app version and physical versus simulator evidence.
- [ ] Mark unavailable hardware tests blocked rather than passing from synthetic evidence.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Deliver executable signal fixtures plus a manual hardware/network matrix; tests substantiate scope without medical efficacy claims.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Execute the matrix on available builds and reconcile every pass/fail/blocker with logs, traffic captures or physical observations.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
